kill_reasons.canonical_source_too_old: Canonical publication date is outside the category freshness window.
kill_reasons.publicity_date_mistaken_for_research_dat: A publicity/pickup date was being used instead of the study's canonical publication date; corrected and re-evaluated.
kill_reasons.creator_source_cooldown: This creator/source family already has a published or commissioned story within the cooldown window.
kill_reasons.repeated_creator_format: This creator's recurring format was recently used and is in cooldown.
kill_reasons.no_channel_relative_breakout: No confident channel-relative breakout baseline; raw views alone cannot support a Strong rating.
kill_reasons.no_new_development: No specific, independently verifiable new development was identified.
kill_reasons.generic_evergreen: Evergreen material without a documented search, traffic or archive-development reason.
kill_reasons.wrong_audience: Not a fit for the Australian men 35-65 audience.
kill_reasons.insufficient_primary_evidence: Primary evidence is missing or cannot be independently verified.
kill_reasons.competition_entity_mismatch: The competition entity was not confirmed in the canonical headline/body with a result verb and event details.
kill_reasons.archive_cannibalisation: Substantially duplicates existing MFO coverage of the same topic.
kill_reasons.creator_drama: Creator drama or reaction content without new information.
kill_reasons.promotional_source_without_independent_v: Promotional/brand source without independent verification or value beyond retelling.
kill_reasons.diversity_cap_reached: Slate diversity constraint (creator/research/topic cap) already satisfied.
kill_reasons.score_below_threshold: Final score below the editorial viability threshold.
